caseName: Cyan, Inc. v. Beaver Cnty. Emps. Ret. Fund
caseNameFull: CYAN, INC. v. BEAVER COUNTY EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT FUND

opinions.text: Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted in part, and the time is to be divided as a follows: 30 minutes for petitioners, 25 minutes for respondents, and 10 minutes for the Solicitor General.
